definitions.explanation: The craft or activity of shaping, carving, and building things from wood. Also refers to items produced through woodworking.

examples.japanese: {木工|もっこう}{教室|きょうしつ}に{通|かよ}っている。
{父|ちち}は{趣味|しゅみ}で{木工|もっこう}をしている。
examples.english: My father does woodworking as a hobby.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{伝統的|でんとうてき}な{木工|もっこう}{技術|ぎじゅつ}で{知|し}られ、{精巧|せいこう}な{家具|かぐ}が{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: This area is known for its traditional woodworking techniques, and finely crafted furniture is made here.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木工|もっこう}{教室|きょうしつ}: woodworking class
- {木工|もっこう}{製品|せいひん}: woodworking products
- {木工|もっこう}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: woodworking techniques
- {木工|もっこう}{用|よう}{接着剤|せっちゃくざい}: wood glue
- {木工|もっこう}{細工|ざいく}: woodwork, wood craftsmanship

RELATED WORDS:
- {大工|だいく}: carpenter (person who builds structures)
- {彫刻|ちょうこく}: sculpture, carving
- {木製|もくせい}: wooden, made of wood
